# Third-party runtime sources

Unmodified cubing.js 0.66.1, published by cubing, under MPL-2.0. Source: https://github.com/cubing/cubing.js. The complete published runtime directory is included.

Unmodified three.js 0.170.0 source modules, under MIT. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js. Runtime modules are resolved by a native browser import map.

Kenney Cursor Pack 1.1, under Creative Commons Zero (CC0). Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/cursor-pack. The two unmodified grip sprites and original license are in `kenney-cursors/`.
